waypoints.title: The Central Molecular Zone
waypoints.description: Spitzer/IRAC 8 micron. The red outline is the ACES footprint - the actual ALMA mosaic coverage, not a bounding box: uniform coverage of all the gas in the inner 100 pc of the Galaxy.

waypoints.title: ACES
waypoints.description: ALMA 100 GHz continuum feathered with the GBT MUSTANG-2 90 GHz map, fading in over the Spitzer view: >50x the sensitivity and >10x the angular resolution of what came before.

waypoints.title: The Dust Ridge
waypoints.description: Zooming into the dust ridge, the chain of massive clouds strung along the near side of the CMZ.

waypoints.title: Dust Ridge Cloud e/f
waypoints.description: A single cloud, about 5 pc across, resolved by ACES at 1.5 arcsec.

waypoints.title: The Same Cloud With Spitzer
waypoints.description: Fading the millimeter data away leaves the Spitzer view of the same cloud: a dark patch, and little else.

waypoints.title: The Same Cloud With JWST
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam on the same field. The cloud that was a shadow at 8 micron resolves into stars, ice absorption, and shocked gas.

waypoints.title: All the Way In
waypoints.description: The last step of the zoom, at JWST resolution. From the whole Central Molecular Zone to individual young stars in six moves.
